description: FDA places full clinical hold on Phase 2 trial due to serious AEs

raw_document.title: KappaBio Receives FDA Full Clinical Hold on KPB-101 Phase 2 Trial
raw_document.raw_text:
KappaBio Therapeutics (NASDAQ: KPBI) today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has placed a full clinical hold on the company's Phase 2 BEACON trial (NCT05234123) evaluating KPB-101 (kappatinib) in patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

The clinical hold was issued following reports of two cases of serious immune-mediated pneumonitis (Grade 4) in trial participants, one of which resulted in a patient fatality. The cases occurred within 8 weeks of initiating treatment at the 10 mg/kg dose level.

All patients have been notified and dosing has been halted across all dose cohorts pending FDA review. The company has 30 days to respond to the FDA's clinical hold letter.

KappaBio is preparing a comprehensive clinical hold response that will include a detailed safety analysis, proposed risk mitigation measures, and a revised study protocol with enhanced safety monitoring.

'We are deeply saddened by this serious outcome and our hearts go out to the patient and their family,' said Chief Medical Officer Dr. Elena Rodriguez. 'Patient safety is our paramount concern, and we are working urgently with the FDA to understand these events and determine a path forward.'

The clinical hold will delay the expected timeline for Phase 2 data by at least 6 to 12 months. KappaBio will provide further updates as information becomes available.
